help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:444  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:445  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:446  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:447  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:448  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:449  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:451  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:452  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:454  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:456  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:457  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:460  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:463  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:466  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:469  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:470  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:473  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:476  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:479  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:488  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:489  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:490  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:491  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:495  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:496  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:497  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:498  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:499  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:500  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:501  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:503  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:504  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:507  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:509  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:510  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:511  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:512  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:513  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:514  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:515  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:516  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:517  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:518  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:519  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:520  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:521  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:522  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:523  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:524  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:525  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:527  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:530  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  Emit one JSON object on stdout instead of the human report. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:534  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541  Repository path override.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:553  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:559  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:565  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:571  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:572  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:577  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:580  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:581  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:582  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:583  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:585  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:587  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:588  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:590  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:591  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:592  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:594  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:597  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:600  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:603  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:606  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:609  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:610  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  Masterkey file override.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:647  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:649  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:650  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:652  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:653  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:655  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. Conversation
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:656  text is fetched and decrypted only when you click a session and then
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:657  click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit codes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:658  match `search`: 0 served the dashboard, 1 read it all and there was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:659  nothing, 3 could not finish reading (or no key), 2 usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:661  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:662  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:664  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:665  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:666  Reads complete `deepseek-<sessionId>.json` exports from `--inbox`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:667  (skipping `.part` files), archives each as one record in a sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:668  shard under `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<id>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`, and retires
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:669  the source file to `<inbox>/consumed/`. Idempotent by content: the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:670  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:672  Inbox directory holding the ext exports.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:679  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  Harness sources are opened read-only. File-backed JSONL sources use a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:691  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  collected; 3 = PARTIAL — the pass ran, but at least one harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  recognised sessions this build cannot archive (the `not archivable`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:723  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:724  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:725  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:726  Gated by `data/harness-registry-v1.json` (`seal_policy` + `seal_source`

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:738  stage are rejected and left untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:746  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:749  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:757  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:760  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:762  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:807  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:809  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:813  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:836  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:841  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:895  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  With `--rebuild --destination`, every archived session for that machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  is restored to a temporary child of `--stage`, the full index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  rebuilt, and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing snapshots
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  remain immutable. No snapshot is written until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  session restore finish, and only the named machine partition is pushed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  The rebuild is safe to re-run, but each run starts over and is not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  resumable. A same-machine snapshot found before publication restarts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide that newer session.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  Metadata only: the extraction keeps a timestamp per line and throws the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  line away. Nothing else about a conversation is ever read, kept or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  printed — the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  destination rebuild. Temporary restored shards are removed after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927  the new snapshot is written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:940  Destination to rebuild from and append the repaired snapshot to.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  Requires `--rebuild`; either this or `--repo` must be named.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:985  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:986  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:987  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:988  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:990  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:991  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:993  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:996  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1002  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1006  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1007  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1010  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1013  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1014  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1031  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1034  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1038  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1039  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1040  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1041  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1042  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1043  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1046  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1049  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1052  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1055  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1058  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1063  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1064  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1065  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1066  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1067  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1068  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1071  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1080  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1082  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  the next time a session is read.
